def: An operation in which each position takes a weighted average of value vectors, with weights computed from how well its query matches each key.
The vector a position uses to ask which other positions are relevant to it.
The vector attached to each position that is compared with queries to decide how much that position is read.
The vector attached to each position that is passed on, in proportion to its attention weight, when the position is read.
Attention in which the queries, keys and values are all computed from the same sequence.
The function softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k)) V, where the scaling keeps the score variance at one whatever the key width.
The softmax output for one query: non-negative numbers over the positions it may read, summing to one.
A lower-triangular mask that sets the scores of future positions to minus infinity so a token can only attend to itself and earlier tokens.
A mask that stops queries attending to the dummy tokens used to pad short sequences to a common batch length.
Running several attention operations in parallel on slices of the model width and combining their outputs with a learned matrix.
One of the parallel attention operations in a multi-head layer, with its own query, key and value projections.
Attention whose queries come from one sequence and whose keys and values come from another.
A pair of attention heads that, having seen the pattern A B earlier in the context, predict B when A appears again.
